sections.heading: What a BMW Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: A professional engine rebuild returns your BMW's engine to factory-standard performance and reliability. Here's what the process includes at our workshop:

items: **Full removal and strip-down** — Every component is disassembled, from pistons and rods to the cylinder head and crankshaft.
**Precision measurement** — Cylinder bores, bearing clearances, and valve clearances are checked against BMW's factory tolerances.

**Machine work** — Cylinders are bored and honed, crankshaft journals ground, and cylinder heads resurfaced. BMW aluminium components are hot-washed and aqua-blasted; engine blocks laser-cleaned before re-enamelling.
**High-quality replacement parts** — New pistons, rings, bearings, gaskets, seals, and a full timing chain kit are installed. Valve cover gaskets and cooling system parts are also renewed.
**Reassembly and testing** — Everything is torqued to BMW specification, VANOS is verified for correct operation, and compression/leak-down tests confirm a perfect seal before reinstallation.

blocks.html: We use BMW-specific diagnostic software (ISTA) for post-rebuild testing and adaptation resets, ensuring your engine runs exactly as it should.
Our rebuild prices are fixed, transparent, and include all parts, labour, and machining. No hidden extras.
Every rebuild includes a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty. Nationwide engine recovery available from £70. Turnaround typically 3-5 days.
We rebuild engines across the entire BMW range, from the 1 Series to the X7 and M models.

We also rebuild [2 Series](/bmw-2-series-engines), [4 Series](/bmw-4-series-engines), [6 Series](/bmw-6-series-engines), [7 Series](/bmw-7-series-engines), [8 Series](/bmw-8-series-engines), [X1](/bmw-x1-engines), [X2](/bmw-x2-engines), [X3](/bmw-x3-engines), [X4](/bmw-x4-engines), [X6](/bmw-x6-engines), [X7](/bmw-x7-engines), [Z4](/bmw-z4-engines), and [XM](/bmw-xm-engines).

steps.title: Removal & Teardown
steps.body: The engine is fully removed and completely disassembled. All parts are laid out for inspection.

steps.title: Precision Measurement
steps.body: Cylinder bores, bearing clearances, and crankshaft journals are measured against BMW factory tolerances.

steps.title: Machine Work
steps.body: Boring, honing, crankshaft grinding, and cylinder head resurfacing. Alusil cylinders are honed using the correct specialist procedure.

steps.title: Component Replacement
steps.body: New pistons, rings, bearings, gaskets, seals, and a full timing chain kit are installed. Valve cover gaskets and cooling system parts are also renewed.

steps.title: Reassembly & Testing
steps.body: Everything is torqued to BMW specification. VANOS is verified with BMW timing tools. Compression and leak-down tests confirm a perfect seal.

steps.title: Reinstallation & Road Test
steps.body: The rebuilt engine is refitted, all systems are checked with BMW ISTA, and the vehicle is road-tested before collection.

items.q: How long does a BMW engine rebuild take?
items.a: A full BMW engine rebuild typically takes several days to weeks, depending on the engine complexity and parts availability. We aim for a 3-5 day turnaround for most rebuilds.

items.q: What is the warranty on a BMW engine rebuild?
items.a: We offer a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty on all our BMW engine rebuilds, giving you peace of mind.

items.q: Do you offer collection and delivery?
items.a: Yes, we provide nationwide engine recovery from £70.

items.q: How much does a BMW engine rebuild cost?
items.a: Prices start from £1,900 for 4-cylinder engines, £2,800 for 6-cylinder engines, and from £4,500 for V8 and performance models. Contact us for a fixed quote for your specific engine.

items.q: Do you use genuine BMW parts?
items.a: We use a combination of genuine BMW parts and high-quality OEM equivalents, depending on availability and what's best for your engine. All parts meet or exceed BMW specifications.
